kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Finished cable and harness references for this interface or application.
intro.zh: 此接口或应用方向的成品电缆与线束参考。

intro.en: Connector, wire and process-material references for project selection.
intro.zh: 供项目选型的连接器、线材与工艺材料参考。

copy.en: Confirm whether PTFE is the insulation, jacket or coax dielectric before specifying the termination.
copy.zh: 端接设计前确认PTFE属于绝缘、护套还是同轴介质。

copy.en: Define conductor alloy, plating, gauge and the actual connector or free-end preparation.
copy.zh: 定义导体合金、镀层、线规及实际接口或自由端处理。

copy.en: Approve the stripping method and dimensions with limits for insulation cuts and conductor damage.
copy.zh: 确认剥线方法和尺寸，并规定绝缘切伤及导体损伤限值。

copy.en: Review soldering exposure or crimp conditions for the selected wire and connector combination.
copy.zh: 按所选线材与接口组合审核焊接热暴露或压接条件。

copy.en: Select strain relief and sealing methods that suit the low-adhesion fluoropolymer surface.
copy.zh: 选择适合低附着力氟聚合物表面的应力释放与密封方法。

copy.en: Agree electrical, mechanical and temperature verification for the finished assembly rather than using a bulk-material rating.
copy.zh: 约定成品组件的电气、机械与温度验证，不能直接套用原材料额定值。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

description.en: Shielded PTFE sensor cable assembly with free wire ends
description.zh: 屏蔽PTFE传感器电缆组件，另一端为自由线端

description.en: RF cable material with PTFE dielectric

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: The verified references are shown at their actual counts. Identify the required interface and configuration before manufacture or sourcing.
reason.zh: 按实际数量展示已核验参考编号，制作或采购前确认所需接口与配置。
